Overview

Dracula (Unholy King) is a Secret Limited unit. He can only be obtained by evolving Dracula.

Evolving

Dracula (Unholy King) can be evolved from Dracula with the following materials:

Required Items: x1 Dracula
x1 Unholy Pistols Unholy Pistols
x12 Star Fruit
x5 Star Fruit (Red)
x4 Star Fruit (Pink)
x4 Star Fruit (Green)
x1 Star Fruit (Rainbow)
Result
Dracula (Unholy King)

Before evolving this unit, the unit must have 5000 Takedowns. [1]

Why do I have different stats?
Units in this game use a randomized system, where stats like damage are randomly rolled with about a 10% variance (like Dungeon Quest items). When you evolve a unit they also reroll their stats, but it will always be strictly better than the pre-evolved version.

Active Ability: Soul Restraint: Level 0

When the moon turns red and the area is encased in a bloody fog, Dracula (Unholy King) lets go of all restraints and summons a total of 20 units from the base, composed of 15 Ghouls and 5 Ghoul Riders, with the Ghoul Riders having 2 bars, letting them collide with enemies twice.

Note that the Ghoul Riders would clip through enemies when they hit them with the first bar.

  • Global Cooldown: 120s

Selling

Units sell for 25% of their deployment cost and upgrades.

Trivia

  1. ↑ Takedowns refer to kills or assists
